title: ChainFolio
tagline: ChainFolio is a multichain portfolio manager that tracks and optimizes your ERC20 tokens across chains. Find the best yield, get investment suggestions, and bridge tokens seamlessly with drag-and-drop. Manage everything from one place and maximize your returns effortlessly
description:
ChainFolio is a  multichain portfolio manager designed to empower users to manage their ERC20 tokens across various blockchain networks efficiently. The platform addresses the growing need for seamless token management, yield optimization, and cross-chain interactions in the rapidly expanding DeFi ecosystem.

Key Features:
Multichain Yield Optimization:
ChainFolio tracks and compares the yield opportunities for your ERC20 tokens across different chains. For example, if you're earning 4% APY on USDC on the Base chain, but Optimism offers 6%, ChainFolio will not only highlight this difference but also suggest that you consider moving your assets to take advantage of the higher yield.

Token Bridging with Drag-and-Drop:
The platform simplifies the process of moving tokens between chains with an intuitive drag-and-drop feature. Users can easily bridge their assets from one chain to another, ensuring they can capitalize on the best opportunities without the hassle of navigating multiple platforms.

LayerZero Integration:
To enable seamless cross-chain transactions, ChainFolio leverages LayerZero, a cutting-edge protocol designed for omnichain asset transfers. This integration ensures that users can bridge their tokens securely and efficiently between supported chains.

Hypersync for Real-Time Data:
ChainFolio uses Hypersync to fetch and display user positions from Aave protocols across multiple chains. This integration ensures that users have real-time visibility into their investments, allowing them to make informed decisions based on the latest data.

Stargate V2 and LzCompose:
The platform incorporates Stargate V2 for token bridging, utilizing LzCompose and other functions that enhance the bridging process. This setup allows ChainFolio to take automated actions once tokens reach their destination chain, further streamlining the user experience.
Comprehensive Portfolio Management:

Vision:
ChainFolio aims to be the go-to platform for crypto investors looking to maximize their returns in the DeFi space. By simplifying complex processes like cross-chain token bridging and yield optimization, ChainFolio allows users to focus on what matters most—growing their investments. The integration of advanced protocols like LayerZero and Stargate V2 positions ChainFolio at the forefront of innovation in the multichain ecosystem, ensuring that users have access to the best tools and opportunities in the market.

With ChainFolio, managing a diversified portfolio across multiple blockchains has never been easier.
how_its_made:
Frontend: Built with Next.js for performance and SEO, Tailwind CSS for styling, and Framer Motion for animations. We integrated custom drag-and-drop functionality for a seamless user experience.

Smart Contracts: Developed, tested, and deployed using Foundry, ensuring reliability and efficiency.

Cross-Chain Integration: Utilized LayerZero for secure token bridging, Stargate V2 with LzCompose for optimized cross-chain actions, and Hypersync for real-time data from Aave protocols.
